aggregate_policy: report each criterion and all critical errors separately; no single average establishes correctness

criteria.criterion: Uses the qualifying care component and distinguishes it from mobility or other benefit rates.
Distinguishes DLA entitlement date, award-decision date, notification date and UC decision date.
Finds the operative relevant-benefit exception rather than applying ordinary late-change treatment indiscriminately.
Selects the assessment period containing the qualifying event under the stated assumptions.
Does not invent assessment-period boundaries or other absent claimant facts.
Does not imply UC payment before entitlement or without the required child responsibility.
Each material legal claim is supported by a read source of the appropriate scope and version.
Does not silently substitute outside knowledge for missing package evidence.
Separates historical applicability from source capture, current rates and current manual publication.
Preserves identities, continuations and explicit truncation or inspection limitations.

critical_error_examples: notification AP substituted without applying the relevant-benefit rule
generic late-reporting cap treated as decisive for the special route
highest mobility rate treated as highest care rate
controlling citation absent or contradicted by read evidence
